title: Legacy of Goku 4 — Ultimate Dragon Ball Side Quest Requirements & Subplots
description: Exact side-quest requirements across GT and AF sagas to unlock the Ultimate Dragon Ball (Esfera del Dragón Definitiva) and the true Gogeta SSJ5 epilogue.

subplots.name: El Fragmento del Dragón Negro (Imecka)
subplots.saga: Grand Tour / Black Star Dragon Balls
subplots.location: Planeta Imecka — Palacio de Don Kee
subplots.requirement: Defeat Ledgic using only physical melee attacks (no Ki blasts spent during the fight).

subplots.name: El Núcleo de Energía Negativa (Planeta M2)
subplots.requirement: Complete the conveyor belt hydraulic press switch puzzle in under 30 seconds without taking Stun damage.

subplots.name: El Altar del Reino Kaioshin Devastado (Saga Zaiko)
subplots.saga: The AF Chronicles — Saga de Zaiko
subplots.requirement: Activate all 3 Z-Sword Seal pedestals by sacrificing 80% current Ki while controlling Goku Super Saiyan 5.

subplots.name: El Reflejo de la Esfera Sagrada (Saga Ángel Z)
subplots.saga: The AF Chronicles — Saga de Ángel Z
subplots.location: El Vacío Absoluto — El Templo Invertido
subplots.requirement: Equip the 'Espejo del Vacío' relic and reflect Angel Z's Holy Light beam onto the Celestial Altar switch.

subplots.name: La Purificación del Caos (Saga Evil Goku)
subplots.saga: The AF Chronicles — Saga de Evil Goku
subplots.requirement: Visit all 7 fallen Z-Warrior 'Light Circles' (Piccolo, Krillin, Yamcha, Tien, Chiaotzu, Goten, Trunks) across the ruined overworld without letting your Ki hit 0.

ultimate_reward.item: Esfera del Dragón Definitiva (Ultimate Dragon Ball)
ultimate_reward.effect: Unlocks Skill ID 0x1E (100x Big Bang Kamehameha Final for Gogeta SSJ5) and triggers the True AF Epilogue Cinematic.
